description.en:
Basic Attack

Perform up to 4 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack

Consume STA to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.

Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode

While in Wide Field Observation Mode, Basic Attack is replaced with Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode.
Perform up to 3 consecutive attacks, dealing Fusion DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Consume STA to perform Mid-air Plunging Attack, dealing Fusion DMG. Press Normal Attack within a certain time afterward to cast Basic Attack Stage 3.

Dodge Counter

Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to attack the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
Press Normal Attack shortly after performing this attack to perform Basic Attack Stage 2.

Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode

While in Wide Field Observation Mode, Dodge Counter is replaced with Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode.
Press Normal Attack right after a successful Dodge to counterattack and deal Fusion DMG.
Within a certain time afterward, press Normal Attack to cast Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 3.
description.id:
Basic Attack

Melakukan hingga 4 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Fusion DMG.

Heavy Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.

Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode

Saat dalam Wide Field Observation Mode, Basic Attack digantikan oleh Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode.
Melakukan hingga 3 serangan beruntun yang memberikan Fusion DMG.

Mid-air Attack

Mengonsumsi STA untuk melakukan Mid-air Plunging Attack, memberikan Fusion DMG. Tekan Normal Attack dalam waktu tertentu setelahnya untuk melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 3.

Dodge Counter

Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.
Tekan Normal Attack sesaat setelah melakukan serangan ini untuk melakukan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode

Saat dalam Wide Field Observation Mode, Dodge Counter digantikan oleh Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode.
Tekan Normal Attack tepat setelah Dodge berhasil untuk menyerang balik dan memberikan Fusion DMG.
Dalam waktu tertentu setelahnya, tekan Normal Attack untuk melancarkan Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Tahap 3.

description.en:
Expectation Error

Heal all nearby Resonators in the team and enter the Parry state, during which DMG taken is reduced by 100% for a time. Switching to another Resonator ends this state immediately.
If attacked while in the Parry state, exit the state and cast Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution.
If not attacked while in the Parry state, press Normal Attack to exit the state and cast Basic Attack Stage 2.

Optimal Solution

Stagnate nearby targets and deal Fusion DMG, reducing the cooldown of Resonance Skill - Expectation Error by 2s.
Switching to another Resonator ends the Stagnation effect early.

Distributed Array

While in Wide Field Observation Mode, Resonance Skill is replaced with Resonance Skill - Distributed Array.
Heal all nearby Resonators in the team and summon Hover Cannons to strike the target, dealing Fusion DMG.
description.id:
Expectation Error

Menyembuhkan seluruh Resonator tim di sekitar dan memasuki state Parry, di mana DMG yang diterima berkurang sebesar 100% untuk sementara waktu. Berganti ke Resonator lain langsung mengakhiri state ini.
Jika diserang saat dalam state Parry, keluar dari state tersebut dan lancarkan Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution.
Jika tidak diserang saat dalam state Parry, tekan Normal Attack untuk keluar dari state dan melancarkan Basic Attack Tahap 2.

Optimal Solution

Membuat target di sekitar mengalami Stagnation dan memberikan Fusion DMG, mengurangi cooldown Resonance Skill - Expectation Error sebesar 2 dtk.
Berganti ke Resonator lain mengakhiri efek Stagnation lebih awal.

Distributed Array

Saat dalam Wide Field Observation Mode, Resonance Skill digantikan oleh Resonance Skill - Distributed Array.
Menyembuhkan seluruh Resonator tim di sekitar dan memanggil Hover Cannons untuk menyerang target, memberikan Fusion DMG.

description.en:
Attack the targets within the effective range, dealing Fusion DMG.
For every 1% of Mornye's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, this skill gains an additional 0.5% Crit. Rate (up to 80%) and 1% Crit. DMG (up to 160%).
When casting this skill, if a Syntony Field is present, remove it and generate a High Syntony Field.
Can be performed in mid-air.

High Syntony Field

- High Syntony Field lasts for 25s.
- Increases the DEF of all nearby Resonators in the team within the High Syntony Field by 20%.
- Inherits the Syntony Field's boost to resistance to interruption and Off-Tune Buildup Rate.
- Inherits the Syntony Field's healing effect and increases the Healing Multiplier by 40%.
description.id:
Menyerang target dalam jangkauan efektif, memberikan Fusion DMG.
Untuk setiap 1% Energy Regen Mornye yang melebihi 100%, skill ini mendapat tambahan 0,5% Crit. Rate (hingga 80%) dan 1% Crit. DMG (hingga 160%).
Saat melancarkan skill ini, jika ada Syntony Field, hapus Syntony Field tersebut dan hasilkan High Syntony Field.
Dapat dilakukan di udara.

High Syntony Field

- High Syntony Field bertahan selama 25 dtk.
- Meningkatkan DEF seluruh Resonator tim di sekitar dalam High Syntony Field sebesar 20%.
- Mewarisi peningkatan ketahanan terhadap interupsi dan Off-Tune Buildup Rate dari Syntony Field.
- Mewarisi efek penyembuhan Syntony Field dan meningkatkan Healing Pengali sebesar 40%.

description.en:
Mornye's Energy Regen is increased by 10%.
Casting Intro Skill - Convergence restores 20 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.
Casting Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 3 restores 20 points of Concerto Energy, triggered once every 20s.
description.id:
Energy Regen Mornye meningkat sebesar 10%.
Melancarkan Intro Skill - Convergence memulihkan 20 poin Concerto Energy, aktif sekali setiap 20 dtk.
Melancarkan Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Tahap 3 memulihkan 20 poin Concerto Energy, aktif sekali setiap 20 dtk.

description.en:
Casting Resonance Skill - Expectation Error or Resonance Skill - Distributed Array grants Proof of Boundedness to all Resonators in the team:
- Proof of Boundedness lasts for 60s and can be gained once every 5 min.
- When the active Resonator takes DMG greater than 30% of their Max HP, they instead take DMG equal to 30% of their Max HP. This effect can trigger up to 3 times. Proof of Boundedness is removed after triggering it 3 times.
- When the active Resonator takes a fatal blow, they are not downed by this instance of damage. This effect can trigger up to 1 times. Proof of Boundedness is removed after triggering it 1 times.
- When Proof of Boundedness is removed, the active Resonator restores HP equal to 150% of Mornye's DEF.
description.id:
Melancarkan Resonance Skill - Expectation Error atau Resonance Skill - Distributed Array memberikan Proof of Boundedness kepada seluruh Resonator tim:
- Proof of Boundedness bertahan selama 60 dtk dan dapat diperoleh sekali setiap 5 menit.
- Saat Resonator aktif menerima DMG lebih besar dari 30% Max HP-nya, DMG yang diterima menjadi sebesar 30% Max HP-nya. Efek ini dapat aktif hingga 3 kali. Proof of Boundedness dihapus setelah dipicu sebanyak 3 kali.
- Saat Resonator aktif menerima serangan fatal, ia tidak tumbang oleh damage tersebut. Efek ini dapat aktif hingga 1 kali. Proof of Boundedness dihapus setelah dipicu sebanyak 1 kali.
- Saat Proof of Boundedness dihapus, Resonator aktif memulihkan HP sebesar 150% DEF Mornye.

description.en: Attack the target to deal Fusion DMG, then jump into mid-air, clearing all Rest Mass Energy and entering Wide Field Observation Mode.
description.id: Menyerang target untuk memberikan Fusion DMG, lalu melompat ke udara, menghapus seluruh Rest Mass Energy dan memasuki Wide Field Observation Mode.

description.en:
Baseline Mode

While in her default Baseline Mode, Mornye gains Rest Mass Energy.

Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift

When Rest Mass Energy reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift.
Cast Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift to deal Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG. Afterward, Mornye jumps into mid-air, consumes all Rest Mass Energy and enters Wide Field Observation Mode.

Wide Field Observation Mode

Wide Field Observation Mode lasts for 30s.
- Upon entering Wide Field Observation Mode, Mornye generates a Syntony Field.
- While in Wide Field Observation Mode, Mornye gains Relative Momentum.
- If Relative Momentum is below 100 when holding Normal Attack, perform Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Stage 1 to 3 in sequence. If Relative Momentum reaches 100 during this time, cast Heavy Attack - Inversion instead.
- While moving, Mornye continuously consumes STA. STA cannot be recovered while in Wide Field Observation Mode.
- When Dodging with directional input, Mornye starts to fly at speed, which lasts for up to 10s or until STA is depleted or until the Wide Field Observation Mode ends.
- When Mornye is hit or launched into mid-air, press Dodge to immediately recover from the attack, which is considered a successful Dodge. This effect can be triggered up to 3 times, which resets when Wide Field Observation Mode ends.
- Press Jump and Mornye will slowly descend. Before she lands, Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode, Resonance Skill - Distributed Array, and Heavy Attack - Inversion are unavailable. If Jump is pressed when Mornye runs out of STA, she will exit the Wide Field Observation Mode. She will leave the Wide Field Observation Mode also when she Dodges, Jumps, or performs Mid-air Attacks.
Additionally, performing environmental interactions, using Utilities, or switching to another Resonator ends Wide Field Observation Mode. The state also ends when Mornye is no longer airborne.

Syntony Field

- Syntony Field lasts for 25s.
- When the Syntony Field is generated, deal Fusion DMG, considered Resonance Liberation DMG.
- Continuously restores HP for nearby active Resonators in the team within the Syntony Field, triggered once every 3s.
- Increases the Off-Tune Buildup Rate of all nearby Resonators in the team within the Syntony Field by 50%.
- Enhances the resistance to interruption of nearby active Resonators in the team within the Syntony Field.

Heavy Attack - Inversion

- When Relative Momentum reaches 100 points, Heavy Attack is replaced with Heavy Attack - Inversion.
- Consume all Relative Momentum to cast Heavy Attack - Inversion, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
- Heavy Attack - Inversion inflicts Observation Marker upon the target on hit for 30s.

Observation Marker

When a Resonator in the team deals Tune Break DMG to a target inflicted with Observation Marker, Mornye inflicts an Interfered Marker on the target for 8s.

Interfered Marker

Targets affected by Tune Rupture - Interfered or Tune Strain - Interfered take increased DMG from all nearby Resonators in the team. For every 1% of Mornye's Energy Regen exceeding 100%, their DMG is increased by 0.25%, up to 40%.

Visual Field

When a Resonator in the team defeats a target inflicted with Observation Marker or Interfered Marker, Mornye gains Visual Field for 3s. While in this state, Mornye inflicts Observation Marker on the target hit whenever any Resonator in the team deals damage.

Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet

Mornye deals one instance of Fusion DMG to targets in the Tune Rupture - Interfered state within range, considered Tune Rupture DMG.

Rest Mass Energy

Mornye can hold up to 100 points of Rest Mass Energy.
While in Baseline Mode, she gains Rest Mass Energy when performing Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, or when Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution hits a target.

Relative Momentum

Mornye can hold up to 100 points of Relative Momentum.
While in Wide Field Observation Mode, she gains Relative Momentum when Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode, Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode or Resonance Skill - Distributed Array hits the target.
Mornye cannot gain Relative Momentum during Heavy Attack - Inversion.
description.id:
Baseline Mode

Saat dalam Baseline Mode default-nya, Mornye mendapat Rest Mass Energy.

Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift

Saat Rest Mass Energy mencapai 100 poin, Heavy Attack digantikan oleh Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift.
Lancarkan Heavy Attack - Geopotential Shift untuk memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG. Setelahnya, Mornye melompat ke udara, mengonsumsi seluruh Rest Mass Energy dan memasuki Wide Field Observation Mode.

Wide Field Observation Mode

Wide Field Observation Mode bertahan selama 30 dtk.
- Saat memasuki Wide Field Observation Mode, Mornye menghasilkan Syntony Field.
- Saat dalam Wide Field Observation Mode, Mornye mendapat Relative Momentum.
- Jika Relative Momentum di bawah 100 saat menahan Normal Attack, lakukan Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode Tahap 1 hingga 3 secara berurutan. Jika Relative Momentum mencapai 100 selama itu, lancarkan Heavy Attack - Inversion sebagai gantinya.
- Saat bergerak, Mornye terus mengonsumsi STA. STA tidak dapat dipulihkan saat dalam Wide Field Observation Mode.
- Saat Dodge dengan input arah, Mornye mulai terbang dengan cepat, bertahan hingga 10 dtk atau hingga STA habis atau hingga Wide Field Observation Mode berakhir.
- Saat Mornye terkena serangan atau terlempar ke udara, tekan Dodge untuk langsung memulihkan diri dari serangan tersebut, yang dianggap sebagai Dodge berhasil. Efek ini dapat aktif hingga 3 kali, dan di-reset saat Wide Field Observation Mode berakhir.
- Tekan Jump dan Mornye akan turun perlahan. Sebelum mendarat, Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode, Resonance Skill - Distributed Array, dan Heavy Attack - Inversion tidak tersedia. Jika Jump ditekan saat STA Mornye habis, ia akan keluar dari Wide Field Observation Mode. Ia juga akan keluar dari Wide Field Observation Mode saat melakukan Dodge, Jump, atau Mid-air Attack.
Selain itu, melakukan interaksi lingkungan, menggunakan Utilities, atau berganti ke Resonator lain mengakhiri Wide Field Observation Mode. State ini juga berakhir saat Mornye tidak lagi berada di udara.

Syntony Field

- Syntony Field bertahan selama 25 dtk.
- Saat Syntony Field dihasilkan, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Resonance Liberation DMG.
- Memulihkan HP secara terus-menerus untuk Resonator tim aktif di sekitar dalam Syntony Field, aktif sekali setiap 3 dtk.
- Meningkatkan Off-Tune Buildup Rate seluruh Resonator tim di sekitar dalam Syntony Field sebesar 50%.
- Meningkatkan ketahanan terhadap interupsi Resonator tim aktif di sekitar dalam Syntony Field.

Heavy Attack - Inversion

- Saat Relative Momentum mencapai 100 poin, Heavy Attack digantikan oleh Heavy Attack - Inversion.
- Konsumsi seluruh Relative Momentum untuk melancarkan Heavy Attack - Inversion, memberikan Fusion DMG, dianggap sebagai Heavy Attack DMG.
- Heavy Attack - Inversion memberikan Observation Marker pada target yang terkena selama 30 dtk.

Observation Marker

Saat Resonator tim memberikan Tune Break DMG kepada target yang terkena Observation Marker, Mornye memberikan Interfered Marker pada target selama 8 dtk.

Interfered Marker

Target yang terkena Tune Rupture - Interfered atau Tune Strain - Interfered menerima DMG lebih besar dari seluruh Resonator tim di sekitar. Untuk setiap 1% Energy Regen Mornye yang melebihi 100%, DMG mereka meningkat sebesar 0,25%, hingga 40%.

Visual Field

Saat Resonator tim mengalahkan target yang terkena Observation Marker atau Interfered Marker, Mornye mendapat Visual Field selama 3 dtk. Dalam state ini, Mornye memberikan Observation Marker pada target yang terkena setiap kali Resonator tim memberikan damage.

Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet

Mornye memberikan satu kali Fusion DMG kepada target dalam state Tune Rupture - Interfered dalam jangkauan, dianggap sebagai Tune Rupture DMG.

Rest Mass Energy

Mornye dapat menyimpan hingga 100 poin Rest Mass Energy.
Saat dalam Baseline Mode, ia mendapat Rest Mass Energy saat melakukan Basic Attack, Heavy Attack, Dodge Counter, atau saat Resonance Skill - Optimal Solution mengenai target.

Relative Momentum

Mornye dapat menyimpan hingga 100 poin Relative Momentum.
Saat dalam Wide Field Observation Mode, ia mendapat Relative Momentum saat Basic Attack - Wide Field Observation Mode, Dodge Counter - Wide Field Observation Mode, atau Resonance Skill - Distributed Array mengenai target.
Mornye tidak dapat mendapat Relative Momentum selama Heavy Attack - Inversion.

description.en:
Mornye can respond to Tune Rupture - Interfered and Tune Strain - Interfered.
- Responding to Tune Rupture - Interfered: When any Resonator in the team deals Tune Break DMG and inflicts Tune Rupture - Interfered, Mornye casts Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet. Each target can be damaged by this skill up to once every 8s.
- Responding to Tune Strain - Interfered: Each stack of Tune Strain - Interfered on the target increases Mornye's total DMG against them. Each point of Mornye's Tune Break Boost increases the total DMG by 0.12%. While Mornye is in the team, the max stack limit of Tune Strain - Interfered on a target is increased by 1.
Mornye can perform Tune Break against the targets with full Off-Tune Level.
description.id:
Mornye dapat merespons Tune Rupture - Interfered dan Tune Strain - Interfered.
- Merespons Tune Rupture - Interfered: Saat Resonator tim memberikan Tune Break DMG dan menimbulkan Tune Rupture - Interfered, Mornye melancarkan Tune Rupture Response - Particle Jet. Setiap target hanya dapat terkena damage skill ini sekali setiap 8 dtk.
- Merespons Tune Strain - Interfered: Setiap stack Tune Strain - Interfered pada target meningkatkan total DMG Mornye terhadapnya. Setiap poin Tune Break Boost Mornye meningkatkan total DMG sebesar 0,12%. Selama Mornye berada di tim, batas stack maksimum Tune Strain - Interfered pada target meningkat sebesar 1.
Mornye dapat melakukan Tune Break pada target dengan Off-Tune Level penuh.

description.en:
Basic Attack – Wide Field Observation Mode becomes immune to interruption.
The duration of Interfered Marker is extended by 150%. Interfered Marker now grants DMG increase even when the target is not affected by Tune Rupture - Interfered or Tune Strain - Interfered. When Mornye applies Observation Marker on a target, she also inflicts Interfered Marker.
description.id:
Basic Attack – Wide Field Observation Mode menjadi kebal terhadap interupsi.
Durasi Interfered Marker diperpanjang sebesar 150%. Interfered Marker kini memberikan peningkatan DMG bahkan saat target tidak terkena Tune Rupture - Interfered atau Tune Strain - Interfered. Saat Mornye menerapkan Observation Marker pada target, ia juga memberikan Interfered Marker.

description.en:
All nearby Resonators in the team gain Crit. DMG increase against targets with Interfered Marker: Every 1% of Mornye's Energy Regen over 100% grants 0.2% Crit. DMG increase, up to 32%.
Syntony Field and High Syntony Field further increase the Off-Tune Buildup Rate of all nearby Resonators in the team by 20%.
description.id:
Seluruh Resonator tim di sekitar mendapat peningkatan Crit. DMG terhadap target dengan Interfered Marker: Setiap 1% Energy Regen Mornye di atas 100% memberikan peningkatan Crit. DMG sebesar 0,2%, hingga 32%.
Syntony Field dan High Syntony Field meningkatkan lebih lanjut Off-Tune Buildup Rate seluruh Resonator tim di sekitar sebesar 20%.
